results.title: Brad Pitt (Actor)
excerpts:
Pitt collaborated again with director Quentin Tarantino in _Once Upon a Time…in Hollywood_ (2019), for which he earned an Oscar and a Colden Globe. More recent films include _Ad Astra_ (2019), _The Lost City_ (2022), _Babylon_ (2022) alongside Margot Robbie and _Wolfs_ for Apple, in which he starred alongside George Clooney.
Pitt’s latest blockbuster film is _F1_ , directed by Joseph Kosinski, in which he stars as underdog racecar driver Sonny Hayes.
